notes: Removed Pokemon (card games) as a fiction franchise; kept Magic the Gathering, Warhammer, Space Hulk, HeroQuest and Arkham Horror as real game brands (Warhammer/Space Hulk are borderline: drop them if game brands with invented universes should go too). Separate: sub-themes of 'horse and animal sports', 'adventure and outdoor sports', 'games of chance' and 'table games' that hold terms, gear or named events rather than sports/games. Not separate: equestrian events, extreme sports, air sports, casino games, board/card/dice/classic games, asian board games, fishing tackle (rod, reel read as fishing words), chess openings (read as chess terms), the athlete sub-themes. Dictionary main forms kept plain: veronica, serac, Novak Djokovic, Martina Navratilova, Ana Ivanovic (English Wikipedia ASCII). St Leger kept without period (British name). Jr. used where it is the usual name (Ken Griffey Jr., Roy Jones Jr., Dale Earnhardt Jr.); Cal Ripken and Floyd Mayweather left without it. Breeders' Cup added to both famous races and famous horse races.
